item.description:
Year: 1987
Video Source: Apple Music
Audio Source: Qobuz - Never Boring & maxinick7

Release Info
The video track is downloaded from Apple Music and left as is (HEVC 10-Bit)
The FLAC track is downloaded from Qobuz and synced by muxing (modified delay, no quality loss).
The DTS & AC-3 track is taken from Maxinick7 release and synced by muxing (modified delay, no quality loss).
The Lyrics are made from scratch. Enable the subtitles to see the lyrics.

This release contains 4 audio tracks
1) Main track (FLAC 24 bit-48 Khz)
2) DTS 5.1 Surround
3) Director's Commentary (DD)
4) Original (AAC Compatibility)
